en.headline: 67-year-old woman dies after aromatherapy fire at Kingswood Villas
en.dek: A woman found unconscious with burns after a flat fire in Tin Shui Wai on Saturday evening died early Sunday morning; police said the blaze was caused by an aromatherapy item igniting nearby objects.
body: A 67-year-old woman died early on Sunday after being injured in a flat fire at Kingswood Villas in Tin Shui Wai the previous evening.

The fire broke out at about 5:39 p.m. on Saturday in a middle-floor unit of Lok Wu House, Block 14. Neighbours reported thick smoke. Firefighters forced entry, extinguished the blaze and found the woman unconscious on a sofa. She had burns to her hands and respiratory tract and was taken to hospital.

She was pronounced dead at 2:50 a.m. on Sunday after more than nine hours of treatment. Police and firefighters said preliminary investigation indicated the fire was caused by an aromatherapy item accidentally igniting nearby objects. No criminal element was found at this stage, and the case is being treated as a fire with a death. About 100 residents evacuated on their own.

zh.headline: 天水圍嘉湖山莊香薰火警 67歲婦抢救不治
zh.dek: 天水圍嘉湖山莊樂湖居一單位周六傍晚疑因香薰燃點雜物起火，67歲女戶主昏迷送院，延至周日凌晨證實不治。
body: 天水圍嘉湖山莊樂湖居第14座一個中層單位周六傍晚發生火警，一名67歲女子經抢救後周日凌晨不治。
火警於周六下午5時39分發生。邻居發現濃煙後報警。消防員破門入屋將火救熄，並在沙發旁發現該名女子昏迷，雙手及呼吸道燒傷，隨即送院。
事主於周日凌晨2時50分證實不治。消防及警方初步調查相信，火警由香薰意外點燃附近雜物引致，現階段無證據顯示涉及刑事成分，案件列作「火警有人死亡」跟進。事件中約一百名居民自行疏散。
